{{Top|leg}}
'''Assistant Advisory Undersecretary of Media''' was a position in the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. A [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]] named [[Uul-Rha-Shan]] saved an [[Unidentified Assistant Advisory Undersecretary of Media|individual]] serving in the position from the [[Duroon Rebels]], while he was working as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for a minor [[Unidentified Millennium Entertainments official|official]] of [[Millennium Entertainments]].
